findings.F1: Inside the rising agitated profile, the tested volume ratio does not order the next 5 days. Its day-clustered slope is -0.0006 per standard deviation (t -0.03, 128 grid cases on BCH, DOGE and ZEC). The excess 5-day return is +0.84 % in the lowest third, -2.37 % in the middle third and +0.27 % in the highest third, so the signal has no monotone grade.
findings.F2: In the profile, the coin's mean 5-day return net of its normal drift is -0.41 % (t -0.26, 128 cases). This explore half shows no reliable drift in either direction that a short could use.
findings.F3: The book's 138 short trades lost on average (-6.48 % net, median -3.90 %), and so did the shorts on every coin: BCH -7.09 % over 52 trades, ZEC -5.93 % over 82, DOGE -9.63 % over 4. The 59 long trades averaged +1.62 % (median -0.17 %). Shorting volume growth in rising agitated markets lost money rather than being merely flat.
findings.F4: None of twelve other bar features predicts the excess 5-day return in the profile. The features were past 1, 3, 5, 10 and 20-day returns, close location, relative range, distance to the 20-day high, short-against-long volatility, volume shock, the up-day count and the tested ratio. All have |t| ≤ 1.38 (100 to 128 cases), and the largest is the 5-day up-day count at t 1.38, which points long rather than short.
findings.F5: Across horizons of 1, 3 and 10 days (24 more tests), the largest reading is the 10-day slope on 10-day against 30-day volatility, t -1.85 on only 43 cases. With about 36 slopes examined, this is within what chance produces. The 1-day slope on the last day's return is t -1.41 (618 cases).
findings.F6: Splits by weekday and year do not show a stable structure on these small samples. Tuesday (-5.0 %, 19 cases) and Thursday (-4.3 %, 19 cases) are negative while every other weekday is between +1.0 % and +1.8 %. 2020 is -3.6 % (42 cases) and 2021 is +1.7 % (70 cases).
findings.F7: The book's active days average -0.006 % (t -0.05, 713 days). The ten best days carry 7.8 % of the absolute daily movement and the ten worst 11.2 %, so no small set of extreme days drives the result.

no_ideas: Across about 36 feature-and-horizon slopes and the weekday and year splits in the rising agitated profile, nothing clears chance (largest |t| 1.85 on 43 cases); in this box, shorts lost on every coin (F3), so the data gives no short-side pattern to build an idea on.
